nodes.label: LSB Steganography
nodes.description: Least-significant-bit steganography hides data in image pixels with minimal visible change; trade-off: simple and high capacity but detectable via statistical analysis

attributes.rationale: LSB chosen for simplicity and capacity; risk is statistical detectability which motivates the AI scorer

nodes.label: AES-256-GCM Encryption
nodes.description: Authenticated encryption ensuring confidentiality and integrity; combined with PBKDF2 to derive key from password

attributes.rationale: AES-GCM provides authenticated encryption so tampered ciphertexts are rejected; PBKDF2 with 600k iterations hardens against brute force

nodes.label: AI Carrier Scoring
nodes.description: Heuristic scoring to rank steganography carrier images before embedding; reduces detectability risk

attributes.rationale: Selecting high-entropy, textured images for LSB embedding makes steganalysis harder; chi-square penalty avoids suspicious LSB distributions

nodes.label: encode_view
nodes.description: Django REST API endpoint (POST /api/encode/) that accepts an image, secret text, and password; encrypts the secret with AES-256-GCM then encodes it into the image using LSB steganography; returns the stego image as a PNG download

nodes.label: decode_view
nodes.description: Django REST API endpoint (POST /api/decode/) that accepts a stego image and password; extracts the hidden payload via LSB decode then decrypts it; returns the recovered secret as JSON

nodes.label: analyze_view
nodes.description: Django REST API endpoint (POST /api/analyze/) that accepts up to 10 images, scores each using ai_scorer.analyze(), ranks them, and returns results with a recommended best carrier image
